base_pose: standing upright on two legs, arms relaxed at its sides

walk.suffix: , performing a full walk cycle in place: the legs striding heel-to-toe one after the other, arms swinging in opposition to the legs, hips counter-rotating with each step, torso held upright and stable, classic looping sprite walk animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: mid-stride, one leg forward with the heel landing and the other pushing off behind, opposite arms swinging forward and back, torso upright, head level

idle.action: standing at ease, shifting its weight
idle.suffix: , chest rising and falling with slow breathing, weight shifting gently from one foot to the other, head turning to look around, arms swaying a little at its sides, gentle looping idle animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: standing upright and relaxed, weight resting on one leg, arms loose at its sides, head raised, eyes open

run.suffix: , the legs driving through a full running stride with the knees lifting high, arms bent and pumping in opposition, torso leaning forward, hips counter-rotating quickly, energetic looping run animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: mid-run stride, one knee driven up high and the other leg extended behind, opposite arms bent and pumping, torso leaning forward, head up

sleep.suffix: , chest rising and falling with each slow breath, one shoulder settling with the rhythm, a hand twitching now and then, eyes staying closed throughout, calm looping sleep animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: lying curled on its side, knees drawn up, hands tucked up near its face, eyes closed

sit.suffix: , chest rising and falling with slow breathing, head turning to glance around, hands resting and shifting on its knees, shoulders settling, gentle looping animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: seated with knees bent and feet flat on the ground, back upright, hands resting on its knees, head raised

eat.action: eating something held in its hands
eat.suffix: , both hands raising the food to its mouth and lowering it again, jaw working as it chews, head nodding slightly with each bite, elbows bending and straightening, small looping feeding animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: standing, both hands holding food up to its open mouth, head tilted forward toward it, elbows bent

jump.action: jumping straight up in an excited burst
jump.suffix: , crouching then driving off both legs and throwing both arms up overhead, the body extending upward then landing and bending at the knees, one reaction jump, no horizontal movement, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: airborne mid-jump, both arms thrown up overhead, knees tucked up, torso stretched upward, face bright with excitement

play.suffix: , one arm waving overhead while the other swings at its side, shoulders bouncing, head tilting side to side, knees bobbing in place, lively reaction loop, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: standing with one arm raised overhead mid-wave, the other arm out to the side, knees slightly bent, head tilted, smiling

fly.action: flying through the air with one arm extended forward
fly.suffix: , clothing and hair streaming back in the wind, the extended arm holding steady while the trailing arm and the legs shift with the airflow, torso held straight and level, steady looping flight animation, hovering in place, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: airborne in flight, body stretched out level, one arm extended forward and the other trailing back along the body, legs straight and together, head raised looking forward
